title: Fat Mouthpiece
description:
The DynaVap Fat Mouthpiece adds an extra bit of comfort to any vapcap. And also creates a seal for any 14mm female WPA.
Please note that vapcaps with the Fat Mouthpiece installed will not fit into the storage tubes or dynastash. The mouthpiece however is very easy to remove and reinstall.
Included
1 x Fat Mouthpiece
